question: What presence of Tripura may arise when the specified mudrās are performed?
premises: Their performance has a ritual effect.
That effect is the presence of Tripura.
inference: Performing these mudrās may bring about the presence of Tripura.
uncertainties: The exact set of mudrās referred to by yābhir depends on prior context.
plain_english: When these mudrās are performed, the presence of Tripura may arise.
